title: Number fields and sticky modifiers
summary: installNumberFields() turns every number input into a calculator-aware scrubbable field (100+20, 50%*2, drag label, pop-up slider) via delegated listeners; evalExpr is the parser. stickyModifiers and ModifierKeysPanel latch shift/alt/mod for pen and touch.
description: One set of delegated document listeners; no field is rebuilt. While focused a field is a text box so operators are accepted; on leaving it is a number box again and the host handlers see one ordinary value. `evalExpr(text, pct)` evaluates + - * / ( ) with unary signs and a trailing percent. `stickyModifiers` holds shift/alt/mod as off, next or latched (double tap within 350 ms latches); the stage ORs them into pointer flags. `ModifierKeysPanel` is the on-screen panel for it.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.signature: export function evalExpr(text: string, pct = 100): number | null
exports.doc: Evaluates + - / ( ) with unary signs and a trailing % (a percentage of `pct`). Null when the text is not arithmetic.
Installs the delegated listeners once; every present and future number field gains arithmetic, scrub and pop-up slider.
One of the three sticky modifiers: shift, alt or mod.
The sticky modifiers (DEV_PLAN 35.3 part c): what the Modifier Keys panel holds for pen and touch users. The stage ORs these into each pointer's shift, alt and mod flags.

The Modifier Keys panel (Window > Modifier Keys): Shift, Alt (Option) and Ctrl (Cmd) buttons. One tap holds the modifier for the next canvas gesture; a double tap holds it until tapped again. Built once;

invariants.text: Build a node once, then patch text, classes, hidden flags and lists in place. Never assign innerHTML or clear textContent on a live container to rebuild it, and reserve space so nothing shifts when content arrives.
installNumberFields is called once at boot; it works through delegation, so fields built later need no call.

examples.title: Install once at boot
examples.snippet:
// Number fields everywhere (ui/number-fields.ts): typed arithmetic, Shift with the arrows steps ten times as far, Return or Escape leaves the field, labels scrub, a pop-up slider.
installNumberFields();
examples.whenToUse: In the boot sequence after panels exist.

examples.title: Modifier panel mount
examples.snippet: new ModifierKeysPanel(q(root, '.cv-layers'));   // Window > Modifier Keys (DEV_PLAN 35.3 part c)
examples.whenToUse: To add the sticky modifier panel to a dock column.
